allele_orientation: Verified allele mappings only; D*z and D*R*D; complements do not automatically negate signs
representation: Original upper/lower triangle established from metadata/source; reconstruct absent opposite triangle only, never missing within-band correlations
raw_diagonal: Must be finite and strictly positive; report minimum, quantiles and maximum. No forced reset. If original release is demonstrated to be a residualized Gram matrix, separately save deterministic R=G/sqrt(diag(G) outer diag(G)), preserving original G; otherwise unit-diagonal departure is unresolved
rank_eigenvalue_threshold: same backward-error tolerance as PSD; report rank and condition; no ridge/PSD projection
numerical_condition_warning: condition > 1/sqrt(eps); unresolved numerical rank requires explicit singular-support diagnostics; never silently invert
scope_limit: Complete frozen locus only; intervals exceeding stored 10Mb radius have unresolved off-band entries and are deferred, never zero filled
coverage: Exact allele-key intersection with exhaustive missing/excluded ledger; ANY missing valid P<5e-8 signal blocks locus. No universal percentage threshold; scientific completeness still must be established
boundary: Report significant-signal distance to all edges and available index coverage; clipped reference ends explicit. Long-range LD cannot be declared absent from banded data
sample_compatibility: PanUKB J44 EUR same-project relationship must be checked against actual globals N and documented release/test; Kim full-EUR LD is external, never in-sample smoking-subgroup LD
statistical_diagnostics: Only when signed statistic and source LD contract valid: z sanity; conditional residual/range-space diagnostics; original SAIGE SPA P is not automatically Wald P. No fit-improving sign flips. No universal mismatch/regularization estimate threshold invented
clearance: Execution-cleared requires every applicable prospective gate. Unknown scientific compatibility => INCONCLUSIVE/NOT CLEARED, not numerical pass alone
